title: Add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and representative workload runners + reporting pipeline v28
author: Ava Martinez
description: Add profiling baselines (cold/warm start), representative workload runners for streaming generation, embeddings, and multi-turn chat, and wire those runners into the reporting pipeline v28. Motivation: we need updated baselines for the new kernel selection and batching heuristics landed in runtime v3.4 and representative workloads that exercise streaming+KV cache to detect regressions early. This PR adds: 1) profiling baselines stored as JSON artifacts and an uploader task, 2) three representative workload runners (streaming-gen, embeddings-batched, chat-multi-turn) with configurable sequences and token distributions, 3) integration with reporting pipeline to publish aggregated metrics to the benchmark S3 bucket and BigQuery dataset, 4) CI jobs to run a lightweight profiling smoke test on PRs, and 5) docs and runbooks for reproducing profiling runs locally. Checklist: - [x] Add baseline artifacts and schema - [x] Implement workload runners - [x] Add pipeline tasks and BigQuery schemas - [x] Add CI smoke job and Dockerfile - [x] Add docs and runbook - [x] Validate with nightly job Example baseline summary: {"model":"redwood-7b","sequence":"chat-multi-turn","cold_p50_ms":"78","warm_p50_ms":"12"} Small diffs included for runner configs and pipeline DAG. Related: ENG-4321, ENG-4399. Notes: PR intentionally keeps runtime changes out of this repo; this only exercises the public API and orchestration. CI: initial run failed due to flaky network to S3, retried and passed. Merge: squash and merge after second approval.
